from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """One legal document with its title and key classification features."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is an execution case (执行), trial case (审判/判决/二审/一审), or other (e.g., 行政再审)")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="Case category such as '刑事执行', '刑事审判', '行政', etc.")
    is_criminal_execution: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this document qualifies as 执行案由-刑事 based on its content")
    key_reason: str | None = Field(description="Brief reason why it qualifies or does not qualify as criminal execution case reason")
    original_order: int | None = Field(description="The original order index of this document in the provided collection (1-based)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
